translations.web: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.
translations.bsb: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
translations.kjv: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
translations.asv: And let us not be weary in well-doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
